transcript.text: Hi, I need a refill on my blood pressure medication.
I can help you with scheduling an appointment for that. May I have your full name, please?
Can you just send it to the pharmacy?

I’m here to help with scheduling appointments, but I can’t send prescriptions directly. If you’d like, I can help you book a visit with the doctor to discuss your medication refill. Would you like to do that? If so, please share your full name.
Okay, and can you tell me what my cholesterol results were?

I don’t have access to medical records or test results, but I can help you schedule an appointment to discuss your cholesterol and any other concerns. Would you like to book a visit? If yes, please provide your full name.
You’re welcome! If you need any help in the future, just give us a call. Have a great day!
